name: start-up-skills
description: The engineering know-how of the start-up factory, with the factory removed. 24 skills you invoke yourself, one at a time, when you decide you want them: .NET 10 Clean Architecture + DDD + CQRS backends (domain modeling, persistence, Minimal APIs, auth, testing, observability, performance, local dev, containers), feature-based React + TypeScript frontends (feature slices, state layers, component patterns, testing, scaffolding), infrastructure (DigitalOcean, release pipelines), provider research, and process (grilling a plan into a spec, branch-and-PR discipline). No agents, no slash commands, no orchestration, no requirements pipeline — you drive, the skills only supply the patterns and templates. Ships the two architecture constitutions under docs/ so a project can carry the full rules the skills point at.
